stepDone: Review step 3 of 4 (check findings and revise)
notFoundText: It was deleted or belongs to another company.
title: Copy and image review results
description: {name}: check flagged copy, candidate legal articles, image observations and evidence extraction.
resubmit: Submit again as a new review with these product details

bar.ready: All {total} phrases decided. You can change any decision later
bar.none: No items flagged. This is not a confirmation of legal compliance.
bar.confirmText: '{name}' will be deleted with its findings, grounds and phrase decisions. This cannot be undone.

original.title: Original file
original.note: The original is kept on the server and stays available after analysis.
original.empty: No originals were uploaded for this version.

summary.title: Review summary
summary.partial: Some sections were not fully analyzed. See the processing notices below.
summary.holdCount: {count} phrase(s) on hold because a lookup failed. This is not a problem in the ad; retry or check directly.
summary.chartLabel: Bar chart of phrases by next action, {total} in total
summary.allHint: Click a bar or button to show only that action in the list below.

revision.manualRequired: Enter the copy you want to use.
revision.noSuggestion: No revision has been generated yet. Keep the original or request a rewrite.
revision.retryPlaceholder: Describe the direction for the rewrite (optional).
revision.retryLimit: All {limit} rewrite requests have been used. Keep the original or edit it yourself.
revision.notVerified: No suggestion passed verification. Keep the original if you have supporting evidence; otherwise remove or rewrite the expression.
revision.fallbackLabel: AI suggestion if the material is missing
revision.draftSaved: Your draft is kept in this browser until you save or send it.

card.basisTitle: Candidate legal articles (search results, not a violation verdict)
card.refsTitle: Past enforcement and review cases (reference only)
card.whyRule: This phrase was classified as '{rules}', so it was compared with the provisions below. A linked provision is not a violation finding; the reviewer decides whether it applies.
card.whySearch: No rule type matched, so the closest standard was found by search. Reference only.

list.description: Review why each item was flagged. {summary}
list.title: Copy pre-check and suggested revisions
list.undecided: {count} phrases still need a decision. For each one, keep it, adopt the rewrite or edit it yourself.
list.emptyText: Analysis may not have run, or no copy was extracted. This does not mean the ad is compliant.

modal.uploading: Uploading files and submitting your review.
modal.submissionRetryHint: Your inputs and files are kept. Close this window and try again.
modal.retryHint: Submit a new review with the original file to analyze it again.
modal.runningNote: Analysis continues if you close this window. Results will appear on this screen when it finishes.
modal.doneNote: Check the possible violations and grounds the AI found, then keep, adopt the rewrite or edit each phrase.

activity.retry: Retrying after a temporary error (after attempt {attempt})

evidence.title: Evidence check
evidence.submittedNone: No evidence was used for this review and none is registered on the product.
evidence.matchTitle: {count} ad claims compared with the evidence
evidence.noClaims: The ad has no numeric or test claims to compare with the evidence.

failure.EVIDENCE_PAGE_LIMIT: Over 80 pages, not read. Upload only the needed part.
failure.DOCUMENT_FETCH_FAILED: Could not load the original; it may have expired. Upload it again.
failure.DOCUMENT_PARSE_FAILED: Could not read this file format. Upload a PDF or image.
failure.OCR_UNAVAILABLE: Could not recognize text on scanned page {page}.
failure.PDF_PAGE_LIMIT: Over the page limit, not read.
failure.DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE_OR_EXPIRED: Could not read the document. This older result did not record why.

evidence.productNotUsed: {count} evidence file(s) registered on the product were not used in this analysis.

skip.MODEL_NOT_NEEDED: The AI judged that this ad copy needs no evidence comparison, so it did not read them.
skip.GUARDRAIL_LIMIT: The tool-call limit was reached before reading them.
skip.LOOP_TIMEOUT: Tool selection ran out of time before reading them.

patent.title: Patent check
patent.origin: Found in: {origin}. Check the number against the original yourself. OCR confidence is not provided.
patent.originDefault: number candidates extracted from the ad and evidence
patent.errorText: Only the patent result is on hold. Other review results are unaffected.
patent.errorHint: Check the official API settings, then submit the original as a new review.
patent.unavailableText: No search result was found. This is not treated as no patent or as a mismatch with the ad. Check it with a copy of the patent certificate.
patent.expiredText: The current rights status of this patent is extinguished. Check its title and registration date below. The original certificate alone does not establish current rights.
patent.claimsUnavailable: The patent number and registration details were found, but the claims text was unavailable, so the ad claim was not compared with the patent's scope.
patent.notFoundInClaims: Not found in claims or specification

visual.title: Separate image review
visual.empty: No items, or image analysis has not run. This does not mean the images are compliant.
visual.adjacent: Context from nearby sections or the comparison image is needed.
visual.region: Analyzed region y={from}~{to}%. This does not confirm exact wrinkle positions or actual efficacy.

tiles.title: Review by section
tiles.empty: No findings. This does not mean the ad is compliant.
tiles.imageError: Could not load the original image.
tiles.howTo: The detail page is split where its content changes. Provisions are standards compared by phrase type, not violation findings.

warnings.OCR_CORRECTION_FAILED: Spacing correction failed in {count} section(s); text is used as read.
warnings.OCR_PROVIDER_FAILED: Supplementary text reading failed in {count} section(s). Check those phrases in the original.
warnings.OCR_NOT_AVAILABLE: Text could not be read in {count} section(s).
warnings.VISUAL_UNREADABLE: Images were hard to read in {count} section(s).
warnings.TEXT_REVIEW_PROVIDER_FAILED: The text review model failed, so some phrases were not reviewed.
warnings.TEXT_REVIEW_INPUT_TRUNCATED: The text was too long; only the first part was reviewed.
warnings.TEXT_MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: The text review model is not configured.
warnings.VISION_MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: The image review model is not configured.
warnings.LEGAL_SEARCH_PARTIAL: Legal search failed for some phrases.
warnings.LEGAL_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the legal search service.
warnings.LEGAL_RULE_PROVISION_NOT_LOADED: Some provisions named by the rules are not loaded yet.
warnings.EVIDENCE_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the evidence analysis tool.
warnings.FUNCTIONAL_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the functional report lookup.
warnings.PATENT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the patent lookup.
warnings.CROSS_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the official record checks.
